name: com.tencent.qqmini.minigame.opensdk.MiniGameOpenSdkLoginActivity
description: When a QQ Mini Game asks the user to sign in, this Activity shows the QQ or WeChat sign-in option provided by the linked login module and returns the result to the game.
disableEffect: Sign-in through the matching social account cannot complete, so a mini game that requires that account may not let the user continue.
